title: Fix the Indentation Error
description: The program should print a message only if the number is positive. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 'Positive number' when num is greater than 0.
actualProblem: The body of the if statement is not indented, so Python raises an IndentationError — it expects an indented block after a colon.
explanation: Python uses indentation, not braces, to define blocks of code. Every statement inside an if, loop, or function body must be indented consistently under the line ending in a colon.
